recentItems.title: En Manamae -  Yours Shri | Krishh | Nishanth | Sreedevi | Sai Sundar | Surya Devan | Maya
recentItems.description:
Long-distance love never fails because of distance, but because of the efforts that slowly disappear between two people. With time, distance teaches more than just the pain of being apart. It teaches patience, understanding, and the art of creating moments when being together isn't always possible.
Yours Shri is about Shri — the one who quietly creates those moments for Dev. She creates the paths, the opportunities, and the little reasons that keep their relationship moving forward.

Like Yin and Yang, sometimes one creates the space while the other fills it, each becoming a part of what keeps the whole relationship in balance.

Sometimes, love isn't about who does more.
It's about who quietly makes it possible for the other to do more.

Yours Shri — a song about her, and everything she makes possible.
